title: Static Rounded Helmet and Padded Space Crew
description: One newly authored complete static clothed space-crew character. A continuous broad rounded padded torso and hip body joins two thick separate knee-shaped legs and full projecting flat-soled boots. Two entire bent voluminous sleeves terminate in closed gloves with integral thumb bulges and full short cuffs. A broad neck ring supports a newly drawn rounded helmet with a real shallow inset front well and an integral opaque gold-looking face panel. A complete chamfered rear equipment pack and one blank chest unit root in the suit body. No exposed skin, real-person likeness, text, logo or brand. All body proportions, limb paths and helmet construction are new numerical geometry: not the old apron worker recoloured or dressed, not an extracted three-window diving helmet placed on a mannequin, and no borrowed body mesh. One character prop zero scenes; four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up, horizontal bounds-centred two-boot ground datum. Fixed stylised costume appearance only; the helmet and clothing are opaque solid visual forms without a hidden human or wearable interior. No wearable fit, anatomy accuracy, pressure seal, breathing, oxygen, thermal/radiation protection, life support, spaceworthiness, locomotion, manufacture or safety claim. Separately editable static meshes only; no skeleton, skinning, animation, dressing or interaction made or verified.
